job_postings_fact.description: Job postings with title, remote flag (job_work_from_home), and salary_year_avg. For Data Analyst remote salary averages over top demanded skills, filter job_title_short='Data Analyst', salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL, job_work_from_home=1, then join skills tables.

legislation_date_dim.description: Calendar dimension. Use Dec 31 rows (month_name='December', day_of_month=31) only when the question explicitly needs filtering this table's dates; prefer date() arithmetic for first-term anniversary/retention anchors.

legislators_terms.description: Legislator terms with term_start/term_end. First term = MIN(term_start) per id_bioguide. For Dec-31 cohort retention or years-elapsed anniversary checks, compute assessment_date with date(first_year||'-12-31', '+N years'); do not require joining legislation_date_dim.

skills_dim.description: Skill names (skills) and types. When ranking top-N demanded skills, ORDER BY demand COUNT DESC then skills ASC for stable ties.

skills_job_dim.description: Maps job_id to skill_id for job postings. Use with skills_dim for skill names and demand counts.
